name: @gltf-studio/usage-index
description: Usage-mapping derived view (specs/ux-usage-mapping.md UX-1100..1105): pure entity -> behavior-graph-reference index computed from a document's KHR_interactivity graphs, KHR_audio_emitter extensions, and animation channels. No React, no RenderHost — the Inspector's "Used in behavior" section and the graph canvas's "Reveal in viewport" both build on this one module.
